title: Introducing TaxFormatter: Fix Your Crypto CSV Files in 30 Seconds
description: We're launching TaxFormatter to solve the biggest pain point in crypto tax filing - broken CSV files. Learn how our AI-powered tool saves hours of manual work.
author: TaxFormatter Team

body.raw:
## Why We Built TaxFormatter

Every tax season, millions of crypto traders face the same frustrating problem: **broken CSV files from exchanges**.

You download your transaction history, try to import it into TurboTax or Koinly, and...

❌ "Invalid date format"
❌ "Missing required columns"
❌ "Duplicate transactions detected"
❌ "Unable to parse file"

### The Old Solution: Hours of Manual Work

Before TaxFormatter, you had two options:

**Option 1**: Pay a CPA $150-300/hour to manually clean your data

**Option 2**: Spend 8+ hours learning Excel formulas and fixing errors yourself

Both options are:
- Time-consuming
- Error-prone
- Expensive
- Frustrating

### The TaxFormatter Solution: 30 Seconds

We built an AI-powered engine that:

1. **Detects** your exchange format automatically
2. **Identifies** all errors and inconsistencies
3. **Fixes** missing data, duplicates, and formatting issues
4. **Exports** to any tax platform in the exact format required

**All in 30 seconds.**

### How It Works

#### Step 1: Upload Your CSV
Drag and drop your broken CSV file. Works with Coinbase, Binance, Kraken, and 15+ other exchanges.

#### Step 2: AI Analysis
Our engine analyzes your file and detects:
- Missing dates or amounts
- Duplicate transactions
- Inconsistent formatting
- Exchange-specific quirks

#### Step 3: Instant Fix
We automatically:
- Fill missing data from context
- Remove duplicates
- Standardize date formats
- Add required columns

#### Step 4: Export Anywhere
Download your clean CSV formatted for:
- Koinly
- TurboTax
- CoinLedger
- ZenLedger
- TaxAct
- Or custom format

### What Makes Us Different

#### 🔒 Privacy First
Your data never leaves your browser. We process everything client-side and delete it after 24 hours.

#### ⚡ Lightning Fast
30 seconds average processing time, even for 10,000+ transactions.

#### 🎯 99.9% Accuracy
Our AI has been trained on millions of crypto transactions and knows every exchange format.

#### 💰 Transparent Pricing
Free audit to see what errors we found. Only pay if you want the fixed file.

### Launch Pricing

**Early Access Special** (Valid through Q1 2026):

- **Free Audit**: See exactly what errors we found
- **$9/file**: One-time fix for a single CSV
- **$49/year**: Unlimited files + priority support

### Who It's For

**Perfect for:**
- Active crypto traders with 100+ transactions
- Anyone using multiple exchanges
- DeFi users with complex transaction histories
- Tax professionals managing client data

**Not needed if:**
- You have fewer than 20 transactions
- Your exchange exports perfect CSVs already
- You enjoy spending hours in Excel

### What's Next

We're already working on:
- **DeFi Transaction Support**: Handle Uniswap, Aave, Compound
- **NFT Tax Reporting**: Track NFT sales and royalties
- **Mobile App**: Process CSVs on your phone
- **API Access**: Integrate with your accounting workflow

### Join the Waitlist

We're launching in **Q1 2026**. Join our waitlist to:
- Get early access
- Lock in launch pricing forever
- Receive exclusive tax season tips

**No credit card required.**

### Questions?

**Q: Do you support my exchange?**
A: We support 18+ exchanges including Coinbase, Binance, Kraken, KuCoin, Gemini, and more.

**Q: Is my data secure?**
A: Yes. All processing happens client-side. Your CSV is never uploaded to our servers.

**Q: What if TaxFormatter can't fix my file?**
A: Full refund, no questions asked. We have a 99.9% success rate.

**Q: Can I try it before paying?**
A: Absolutely. Get a free audit showing exactly what errors we found.

### Ready to Stop Fighting with CSV Files?

Start your free audit today.
